entities.name: Gabriel Simo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gabriel Simo  was the Cameroonian Roman Catholic prelate, who served as an auxiliary bishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Douala (1987–1994) and Roman Catholic Diocese of Bafoussam (1994–2013).
